parsed_result.summary: Yes. With identical preprocessing (median/most-frequent imputation, standardized numerics, one-hot categoricals) fit inside each fold, a default RandomForestClassifier reaches a stratified 5-fold CV ROC-AUC of 0.9010 versus 0.9056 for a default LogisticRegression, a gain of -0.0045. The gap is small in absolute terms but extremely consistent: RF won every one of the 25 folds under 5x repeated CV.
parsed_result.primary_metric_name: ROC-AUC difference (RF - LogReg), stratified 5-fold CV mean
parsed_result.methodological_choices: Both estimators at scikit-learn defaults (RF random_state fixed for reproducibility only) inside a Pipeline so preprocessing is fit within each training fold (no leakage). Identical preprocessing for both models: 6 numeric columns median-imputed + StandardScaler; 8 categorical columns most-frequent-imputed + OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'). The 3 columns with true NaNs (workclass 2799, occupation 2809, native-country 857) were imputed rather than dropped or given an explicit 'Missing' category. fnlwgt (a survey sampling weight, not a person-level predictor) was retained as an ordinary feature. Target encoded as >50K = 1 (23.93% positive); no class-imbalance handling, since ROC-AUC is threshold-free and the defaults were specified. Scaling is necessary for lbfgs/max_iter=100 to converge and is a no-op for trees; a sensitivity run with UNSCALED logistic regression gave LR AUC 0.5995 (diff +0.3015), so the direction of the finding does not depend on that choice. A researcher using ordinal instead of one-hot encoding, dropping fnlwgt, or dropping education-num/education as redundant might see slightly different magnitudes.
parsed_result.verification_method: (1) 5x repeated stratified 5-fold CV (25 folds, seeds 0-4), paired per fold, with a paired t-test and a 10,000-resample bootstrap CI on the mean fold-level difference; (2) an independent held-out 20% stratified test split (seed 123, not used in any CV above) with a 2,000-resample paired bootstrap CI on the test-set AUC difference; (3) a sensitivity run of logistic regression without feature scaling.
parsed_result.verification_result: The finding held up. Repeated CV: RF 0.9018 vs LogReg 0.9054, mean difference -0.0036 (bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0044, -0.0028]); RF won 1/25 folds, paired t=-8.7, p=7.3e-09. Held-out split: RF 0.9012 vs LogReg 0.9038, difference -0.0026 (paired bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0068, +0.0016], P(RF>LogReg)=0.120). The revised best estimate of the advantage is ~-0.0036 AUC (roughly -0.004 to -0.003). The effect is highly reliable in sign but small in magnitude.
